title: 广州早茶：一盅两件，慢的艺术｜Cantonese Yum Cha (饮茶先啦)
description:
广州的早晨，是从一壶茶开始的。老广一句话：一盅两件。一笼虾饺，皮薄得透光；烧卖、叉烧包，一样一样慢慢上。但早茶的重点，从来不是吃——是坐下来，和家人聊一个上午。广州甚至为早茶立法保护，是全国头一部。得闲饮茶——饮茶先啦。

In Guangzhou, morning starts with a pot of tea. The guiding phrase is 一盅两件 — "one pot, two bites." A basket of har gow with skin thin enough to see through; siu mai and char siu bao, brought out slowly, one by one. But yum cha was never really about the food — it's sitting down for a whole morning with family. Guangzhou has even passed a law to protect it: on May 1, 2026 the country's first regulation dedicated to morning-tea culture took effect, including a 24-hour freshness window for hand-made dim sum. Free sometime? 饮茶先啦 — let's have tea first.

本片无旁白：以中英双语字幕叙述，配免版税音乐。/ No voiceover — narrated through bilingual subtitles over a royalty-free music bed (no AI narration in this video).
